0221110100122200021 - ASI: 16

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  01 = 0 * 1
  02 = 0 * 2
  11 = 1 * 1
  21 = 2 * 1
  22 = 2 * 2
  010 = 01 * 0
  021 = 0 * 21
  222 = 2 * 22
  0221 = 02 * 21
  00021 = 00 * 021
  01222 = 01 * 222
  11010 = 11 * 010
  022111010 = 0221 * 11010
  0122200021 = 01222 * 00021
  0221110100122200021 = 022111010 * 0122200021
